part: final-b days 1-5 (Tokyo, Kawasaki, Daikoku, Enoshima-Hakone-Fuji drive, Osaka + Nara) + flights into Japan + Toyota one-way car Kawasaki -> Namba

issues.problem: The cheapest twin on Jalan costs ¥32,000 (Sat Jan 23), ¥22,000 (Jan 24), ¥26,500 (Jan 25) and ¥27,000 (Jan 26) for two, about ¥107,500 in total, not the ¥80,000 in the plan (the ¥17,000-25,000 per-night estimate is too low).
issues.fix: Change the hotel cost to about ¥108,000 for two (¥54,000 per person) and the price info line to 'Twin ¥22,000-32,000 per night (Jalan, Sep 2026)'; a double is about ¥3,000 less per night if the two can share a bed.

issues.item: Hanz Outdoor Resort half board price + late check-in
issues.problem: On Rakuten the cheapest half-board plan for Fri Jan 22 (Villa C, 'seasonal dining' dinner + breakfast) is ¥53,600 for two, not the ≈ ¥43,000 in the plan; the Expedia price (CA$401) could not be re-checked (bot wall). Last check-in is 17:00 and the plan arrives 16:40.
issues.fix: Budget ¥54,000 for two unless Expedia still shows CA$401 when you book; tell the hotel your arrival time, and phone the hotel (number on the Rakuten page) if Gotemba shopping runs past 15:45.

issues.item: Car park at Super Hotel Shinjuku Kabukicho (night Jan 21)
issues.problem: The hotel car park has few spaces, costs ¥2,000 per night and can be reserved ONLY by phone; 'ask when you book' online will not reserve it.
issues.fix: Phone the hotel (03-6855-9000) to reserve the space for Jan 21 when you book, else plan a coin car park with a daily maximum near Kabukicho.

issues.item: Aoki's arrival time at the hotel
issues.problem: Aoki lands 18:40 with a checked bag; after immigration (about 1 h) the next TYO-NRT buses leave Narita about 19:40-19:50 and reach Tokyo Station 20:58-21:08, so with the walk to the JR Chuo Line and the ride to Shinjuku Aoki reaches the hotel about 21:30-22:00, not 21:05 (1 h 35 is too short).
issues.fix: Change Aoki's leg to about 2 h 45 (landing to hotel) and the hotel meet to about 21:45, dinner at Omoide Yokocho at 22:00 (it is open to about midnight).

issues.problem: The plan calls it 'Uniqlo Shinjuku-sanchome' but the pin (35.6914, 139.7032) and the 10:00-22:00 hours are 'Uniqlo Shinjuku Honten' (新宿本店, MI Shinjuku Bldg, Shinjuku 3-29-1); the real 'Shinjuku-sanchome store' (新宿三丁目店) is a small store that closes at 21:00.
issues.fix: Rename the place to 'Uniqlo Shinjuku Honten (ユニクロ 新宿本店), MI Shinjuku Bldg 1-3F' and set hours to 10:00-22:00 (Uniqlo store list).

issues.problem: Google Maps gives 4 h 30 of pure driving (399 km) with no traffic, so 4 h 45 including a 25-min break is short on a Saturday; arrival is more likely 13:30-14:00 than 13:15.
issues.fix: Plan 5 h 15 and arrive about 13:45; leave the hotel for Nara by 14:30 (still at Todaiji by 15:30). If Meihan Route 25 has snow, use the Shin-Meishin instead.

issues.item: Toyota Kawasaki: studless tyres in a Tokyo-area shop
issues.problem: Studless tyres are a paid option (¥2,200 per 24 h, 4 units = ¥8,800 confirmed) but the web pages do not show if this shop has a C2 car with studless tyres on Jan 21.
issues.fix: When you book, phone the shop (044-520-3911) to confirm a C2 with studless tyres and an ETC card (¥550, not in the cost list); if none, the nearby Kawasaki shop (川崎店) is the fall-back.

issues.item: Girls Band Cry stamp book in Kawasaki
issues.problem: No official page confirms that the GBC stamp tour and its stamp book are still sold in January 2027 (earlier notes say the spot list changes, and Island Mura Guitars in Lazona closed Sep 2026).
issues.fix: Keep the walk (the places are public), but mark the stamp book 'check in Jan 2027' instead of '¥500 at the plaza'.

issues.problem: The Isetan site (mistore.jp) did not load from here, so the 20:00 closing time could not be checked.
issues.fix: No change needed now; the plan already says to skip Isetan if Pegasis is late (he reaches Shinjuku about 19:15-19:35).
